plan: Resolve excluded ingredients through deterministic, chained substitutions.
Apply wording/equipment changes, exact yield scaling, and aggregate diagnostics.
Preserve `authored_text` and all caller-owned inputs unchanged.
mechanisms: `deepcopy` isolates adaptations from the authored recipe.
A FIFO work queue processes replacement and additional ingredients.
Catalog choices are ordered by `(priority, catalog_index)`.
Scaling is deferred until substitutions establish the effective yield.
Instruction rewrites and equipment changes are applied globally.
Reasons, warnings, and equipment are deterministically sorted.
